old_description: HB Molding was founded in 1998 and originally located in the south side of Louisville. Due to our ability to quickly react to customer demands and opportunities we have grown to a 37-injection molding press operation housed in 78,000 sq.ft. of production facilities on the east side of Louisville with quick access to major North and South interstate roadways. about:
HB Molding was founded in 1998 on the south side of Louisville, Kentucky, by Mark Hallam, who remains the owner. The privately held company relocated to a 78,000-square-foot facility in Jeffersontown on the east side of Louisville, with direct access to major north–south interstates.

The shop operates 35 to 37 injection molding presses ranging from 120 to 500 tons with shot capacities of 4 to 60 ounces, running five days a week, 24 hours a day, with weekend availability for demand spikes. Core processes include injection molding, ultrasonic welding, hot stamping, pad printing, assembly, and tool building, supported by in-house 3D scanning for quality inspection.

HB Molding serves as both a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier to original equipment manufacturers, notably GE Appliance, which recognized the company with a 2017 Supplier Quality Performance Award and a 2018 “Silent Warrior” award. The facility primarily supports customers within a 200-mile radius of Louisville across appliance and industrial manufacturing sectors.

The company emphasizes rapid response to customer needs, a capability that drove its growth from a single location to a multi-press operation. ISO 9001:2015 certification and in-house metrology reinforce its quality system, while proximity to interstate highways enables efficient logistics for regional clients.
